item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We refuse to accept that outcome. Our future must remain ours to decide.

2. We cannot build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years and keep humanity in control. Crossing that threshold means permanently surrendering our future. We must stop this race before it takes that choice away.

3. We stand for a future shaped by people—not one dictated by superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control. We must act now to keep that future in human hands.

### (b) Newsletter opening

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We take that prospect seriously, and we refuse to treat it as the unavoidable price of progress. We believe people must retain the power to decide how we live, what we value, and what world we leave to future generations. That power is not something we can surrender and later reclaim. We must stop the race toward superintelligence and demand binding limits that keep our future in human hands. Our task is clear: organise, build public pressure, and insist that humanity’s continued control comes before any company’s ambition.
